descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Learning Intern , you will join our Global Learning Services (GLS) team within the People Support Solutions (PSS) organization in Roche. In this role, you will assist with executing routine administrative and system data maintenance activities in our Learning Management System ( Cornerstone ). You will gain hands-on learning experience in a shared service environment, supporting learning processes and ensuring high-quality, customer-focused support for our global learning community. Your Key Responsibilities
• System Administration : Execute routine data maintenance and system administrative tasks within Cornerstone and other relevant learning systems in a timely and accurate manner.
• Process Support : Assist with the administrative coordination of various training events, including new employee orientation, leadership training, professional training, and other training requests.
• Customer Support : Help provide customer service and troubleshooting support regarding training records, learning processes, and system inquiries to internal HR experts and business partners.
• Documentation : Assist in keeping team knowledge up to date by contributing to and updating Standard Work Instructions (SWIs) and local Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
• Continuous Improvement : Actively participate in team meetings, workshops, and work-related events to help identify process improvements and support new ways of learning.
• Compliance & Integrity : Perform daily duties with high integrity, adhering to global and local guidelines, including strict data privacy rules and safety, security, and environmental (SHE) regulations. Who You Are We are looking for an analytical, proactive and collaborative university students who bring the following skills and competencies:
• Education : Currently enrolled in a university program with active/passive full-time student status in Hungary (studies in HR, Business, or Social Sciences are preferred).
• Able to work 25-30 hrs/week .
• Languages: Fluent English (C1) is required. German (B2-C1) also required.
• System & IT Skills : Experience with standard IT applications (Google Suite or Microsoft) and an eagerness to learn cloud-based learning management software (like Cornerstone).
• Growth Mindset : An agile learner who is open to seeking and giving feedback, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, and capable of navigating complex data.
• Customer Centricity : Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a focus on delivering reliable support and managing customer expectations.
• Collaboration : A supportive team player who enjoys working in a multicultural, cross-border matrix environment. What We Offer
• Hands-on experience operating Cornerstone and various other tools.
• Deep exposure to a global Shared Service Center environment.
• Competitive salary.
• A collaborative and supportive team environment that values your development and continuous learning.
• Flexible working hours according to your studies. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changi
